Title: Access control
Text: The system shall require an authenticated user before displaying maintenance records.

Title: Search response time
Text: The system shall return maintenance record search results within 2 seconds when the database contains up to 50000 records.

Title: Export usability
Text: The export workflow should be easy and user-friendly as needed for reviewers.

Title: Audit event logging
Text: The system shall record the actor, timestamp, action, and record identifier for each maintenance record change.

Title: Combined notifications
Text: The system shall email the reviewer when a record changes and shall create an audit entry for the notification.

Title: Duplicate access control
Text: The system shall require an authenticated user before displaying maintenance records.
